meta.description: Escalation for stalled waits, failed deliveries, and safe manual resume. Never auto-regenerates Flow prompts.

parameters.content:
On timeout / stalled human upload:
1. Send actionable notification (project, scene, Flow Package link).
2. Do NOT assume upload failed solely because Wait timed out.
3. Do NOT automatically regenerate or re-submit a Flow prompt.
4. Operator cancellation / video cancellation / pause must stop the run safely.
5. After n8n or app restart, resume only after authoritative ASF status confirms the scene.
